firstDownloadTrust: GitHub HTTPS delivers the initial script and its verifier/seed pins; compromise of that initial delivery can replace those pins. This is not independent authentication of the first script.
installedUpdateTrust: verify the pinned release signatures, repository/tag-bound build provenance, expiry and persisted sequence/version floors
provenanceRootSource: GitHub CLI gh attestation trusted-root, authenticated using its built-in TUF trust; Sigstore Public Good Instance
artifactAcceptance: not granted; actual installer/artifact/run identities require separate post-build review
